Getting Started
===============

This guide will help you set up and run the Visual Plan Architecture application.

Prerequisites
-------------

- **Node.js**: Version 18 or higher
- **pnpm**: Package manager (or npm/yarn)
- **OpenAI API Key**: Required for AI generation

Installation
------------

1. **Clone the repository:**
   .. code-block:: bash

      git clone <repository-url>
      cd v0-visual-plan-architecture

2. **Install dependencies:**
   .. code-block:: bash

      pnpm install

3. **Set up environment variables:**
   
   Create a ``.env.local`` file in the root directory:
   .. code-block:: env

      OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key_here

4. **Run the development server:**
   .. code-block:: bash

      pnpm dev

   The application will be available at ``http://localhost:3000``

Building for Production
------------------------

1. **Build the application:**
   .. code-block:: bash

      pnpm build

2. **Start the production server:**
   .. code-block:: bash

      pnpm start

Project Structure
----------------

::

   v0-visual-plan-architecture/
   ├── app/              # Next.js App Router
   ├── components/       # React components
   ├── lib/             # Utilities and types
   ├── public/          # Static assets
   ├── docs/            # Documentation
   └── package.json     # Dependencies

Key Dependencies
----------------

- **next**: React framework
- **react**: UI library
- **@ai-sdk/openai**: OpenAI integration
- **ai**: Vercel AI SDK
- **tailwindcss**: Styling
- **@radix-ui/***: UI primitives

Development Workflow
--------------------

1. Make changes to the codebase
2. The development server will hot-reload automatically
3. Test your changes in the browser
4. Build and test production build before deploying

Deployment
----------

The application is configured for deployment on Vercel:

1. Push your code to a Git repository
2. Connect the repository to Vercel
3. Set environment variables in Vercel dashboard
4. Deploy automatically on push

Environment Variables
---------------------

Required:
- ``OPENAI_API_KEY``: Your OpenAI API key

Optional:
- ``NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL``: Application URL (for production)

Troubleshooting
---------------

**Issue: API errors**
   - Verify your OpenAI API key is set correctly
   - Check that you have sufficient API credits
   - Review API rate limits

**Issue: Build errors**
   - Clear ``.next`` directory: ``rm -rf .next``
   - Reinstall dependencies: ``pnpm install``
   - Check Node.js version compatibility

**Issue: Styling not working**
   - Verify Tailwind CSS is configured correctly
   - Check ``postcss.config.mjs``
   - Restart the development server

Additional Resources
--------------------

- `Next.js Documentation <https://nextjs.org/docs>`_
- `Vercel AI SDK <https://sdk.vercel.ai/docs>`_
- `OpenAI API Documentation <https://platform.openai.com/docs>`_
- `Tailwind CSS Documentation <https://tailwindcss.com/docs>`_
